title: Fukuoka
dek: Five days in Kyushu for a party of eight — yatai crawls, Hakata ramen, Dazaifu's shrine, and a coastal day trip to Itoshima. Balanced pace, public transit where it's practical.
verified: ⚠ Pass A (canonical research) — checked 2026-08-29 for the Oct 19–23, 2026 trip. Entry rules, the transit backbone (Fukuoka Airport↔city, Dazaifu, Itoshima), Dazaifu Tenmangu, Kyushu National Museum, Itoshima's coast, central Fukuoka sights, yatai etiquette, and Hakata's regional specialties (ramen, motsunabe, mentaiko, udon) are checked against official/primary sources. Pass B (local/authentic corroboration) and reconciliation have not run yet — some facts below are single-pass only. ⚠ re-check before travel: the Nishitetsu Tenjin–Dazaifu fare (Nishitetsu raised fares system-wide Apr 1, 2026; the current figure is only an unconfirmed ≈¥480 aggregator estimate), Nishitetsu and JR Kyushu exact train times (both lines revised their timetables in Mar 2026), Showa Bus Itoshima frequencies and fares (published only as unreadable PDFs this pass), the US State Department advisory level for Japan (travel.state.gov blocks automated access), Nokonoshima Island Park's admission price (aggregator-sourced only), and Hakata Okunchi's exact 2026 program (inferred from the fixed Oct 23–24 annual date pattern — not yet posted for 2026).
footer: Transit fares, hours, and admission figures are sourced from official operators and city/prefecture tourism sites — tap any citation for the source page.
